Description.Name: UK-MG Ammo 25x
Description.Details:
Capacity: 750
Cartridges or Rounds per Firing: 3
Number of Firings: 250
Heat generated per turn: +10.
Max heat and overheating modifiers: --5.
Damage taken from all sources: 105.0000%.

    Ammo Bins contain the rounds needed for projectile-based weaponry, with at least one bin required per weapon type.  Most Ammo Bins will explode and destroy their installed location when they receive a Critical Hit, however Ultra-Kinetic Machine Gun ammunition is made up of solid high-tech metal alloy metals engineered to have a custom-structured atomic structure, thanks to an open-standard technology developed and by Westonmach.  This solid alloy material makes up all of the rounds, and there is no casing, gunpowder, or chemical components, explosive or otherwise.  As such, there isn't any part of the ammunition to explode or burn if the ammunition or it's storage container gets damaged or even set on fire in combat, so no explosion will occur from a critical hit.

    Ultra-Kinetic Machine Gun Ammo Bins may feed multiple weapons, which do not have to be installed in the same location, thanks to a battlemech's internal mechanisms which feed and transfer ammunition around inside of a battlemech's parts, like any other ammunition bins.

    Westonmach ammuntion bins use magical extradimensional technology to fit their ammunition into a space smaller than the total cubic area of all of the ammunition itself.  In battlemechs, this comes at the cost of weakened total armor for the battlemech, because of the magistics that apply, however the smallest capacity ammunition box of it's type usually does not incur any such tradeoff.  Also, larger capacity ammunition bins will impair the battlemech's cooling capabilities, resulting in a small to moderate reduction in the overheating threshold and also the maximum amount of heat the battlemech can take.

Description.Name: INSTALLED EQUIPMENT HEAT GENERATED TRADEOFF
Description.Details: This Battlemech's equipment generates [AMT] heat per turn, as a trade-off for equipped weapons and other items.

Description.Name: MAX HEAT AND OVERHEAT THRESHOLDS DECREASED
Description.Details: Installed gear of this unit stresses it's coolant and hink sinking systems, creating extra work for heat management and lowering heat tolerance.\nMaximum allowed heat decreased by [AMT].\nOverheat threshold decreased by [AMT].

Description.Name: INSTALLED EQUIPMENT DAMAGE RESIST PENALTY
Description.Details: This battlemech takes [AMT] damage from all sources and types of attacks, as a trade-off for equipped weapons and other items.
